name: tflo-react-validation
description: Reproduction suite proving the claims in the main README. NOT part of the published @tflo/react package. Run as CI evidence: can the incumbent JS libraries (RxJS, XState) express event-time CEP without hand-building an engine?

scripts.all: for s in s1:react s1:signals s1:rxjs:naive s1:rxjs s1:xstate s1:tflo s2:react s2:signals s2:rxjs s2:xstate s2:tflo s3:react s3:signals s3:rxjs s3:xstate s3:tflo; do echo "### $s"; npm run -s $s; echo; done
scripts.tflo: for s in s1:tflo s2:tflo s3:tflo; do echo "### $s"; npm run -s $s; echo; done
